blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: It's a sad story.
exercises.why: These are covered more thoroughly on their own page, but in the nominative case they have only one unique ending: the feminine singular ending for these adjectives is **-яя**, not **-ая**. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: ___ (розничный) торговцы покупают товар оптом, а продают в розницу.
exercises.prompt: A retail merchant buys wholesale and sells retail.
exercises.why: In the nominative case, this only affects plural adjectives: instead of **-ые**, these adjectives have the ending **-ие**. *Новые книги Старые книги Хорошие книги Разные книги* — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
exercises.context: In the nominative case, this only affects plural adjectives: instead of **-ые**, these adjectives have the ending **-ие**.

exercises.prompt: A big spider was spinning a web.
